messages:
alex: FYI I'm splitting the big 'reference' bundle into reference/core and reference/clients. Opening a trio of PRs to avoid a single massive diff: #4330 move, #4331 client-snippets, #4332 redirects. Need reviewers and a safe merge plan.
tara: Can you list which pages will change paths? I want to update the SDK code examples in a single PR if possible.
alex: Sure — summary in the PR description. Biggest changes: /reference/clients/python.md -> /reference/clients/python-client.md, /reference/core/model-ops.md -> /reference/core/model-management.md. #4331 updates Python & TS snippets and renames example imports.
nguyen: I'm available to review snippet changes (#4331). Two quick asks: keep old import aliases for one release (deprecation note) and run unit docs examples via the snippet runner.
leo: Heads-up: netlify preview for #4331 failed: syntax error in a fenced code block in python snippets — triple backticks with wrong language tag caused prism render to choke. Linkcheck still passed but build errored.
docs-bot: preview for PR #4330: https://docs-preview.redwood-inference.net/pr-4330 1430: build passed.
docs-bot: preview for PR #4331: https://docs-preview.redwood-inference.net/pr-4331 1431: build failed (code sample parse error). See logs: `Error: invalid code fence lang at docs/reference/clients/python-client.md:23`
alex: oops my bad, missed one snippet fence when migrating examples. I'll push fix to #4331 in a bit.
tara: Merge ordering: I think #4330 (move) should go first, then #4331 (snippets), and finally #4332 (redirects). But note that #4331 includes imports that will 404 until #4330 lands.
nguyen: Suggest we land #4330 in a quiet window and keep #4331 as a branch-based merge that blocks until its preview is green. That avoids broken previews showing on main.
leo: Also a tip — add a small moves-mapping file at docs/move-redirects.txt inside #4330 so link-update scripts can consume it. Saves manual grep.
docs-bot: preview redeployed for PR #4331: https://docs-preview.redwood-inference.net/pr-4331 1432: build passed after fix. Linkcheck shows 6 anchor warnings.
alex: Those anchor warnings are mostly due to slug changes: e.g. `#model-lifecycle` vs `#lifecycle-of-models`. I'm going to add short alias yaml blocks to the new files for the top 4 anchors.
tara: For redirects (#4332) we need to include an explicit map for client examples: /reference/clients/python -> /reference/clients/python-client and include query-preserving rules. Netlify can't rewrite fragments so we'll pair a small client redirect script as fallback for deep links.
nguyen: Agree on the client-side fallback, but let's keep it behind a flag in the page frontmatter (enable_redirect_fragment: true) so we don't run it site-wide.
leo: CI note: staging build runs `./scripts/snippet-runner` which uses a temporary token. Please mark any network calls in examples as mocked. #4331 had one live curl that caused flakiness.
docs-bot: scheduled merge window: docs merge window 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC. Merge freeze will be posted 10m prior.
tara: I'll coordinate reviews and lock unrelated doc PRs during that 30m window. Can we also ask support to hold any external redirects work those 30m?
alex: I'll add a checklist to each PR: move-map present, snippet-runner green, preview green, alias/frontmatter for anchors, client-fallback added in #4332.
docs-bot: reminder: run `./scripts/linkcheck --verbose` locally to surface ambiguous anchors before pushing.
nguyen: Reviewing #4331 now. If approvals look good I'll request a review from infra for the client fallback JS in #4332.
tara: When #4330 merges, please post here with the merge commit so I can rebase #4331 and run a full local build.
alex: Will do. Thanks everyone.
